test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
The researchers conducted a study to do** light on the effects of climate change on coral reefs.
solution:
The correct answer is '**shed**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct idiom is "**shed light on**," which means to clarify or provide information about something.
 
• The phrase "to do light on" is incorrect and does not convey any meaningful sense.
 
• **Option 4**, "shed
